issues.detail: The Hebrew 'מֵהָלְאָה לְמִגְדַּל עֵדֶר' means 'beyond the tower of Eder' (i.e., past/on the other side of Migdal-eder), not 'from Harel to Migdal-eder'. The Chinese renders 'מֵהָלְאָה' as '從哈列' (from Harel), which misidentifies the prepositional phrase as a place name and changes the meaning.
